<?php

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $refCounts = [];
    private static ?ConnectionPool $instance = null;

    public static function getInstance(): self {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }

    public function acquire(string $dsn): int {
        $connId = crc32($dsn) & 0x7FFFFFFF;
        if (!isset($this->connections[$connId])) {
            $this->connections[$connId] = imagecreatetruecolor(1, 1);
            $this->refCounts[$connId] = 0;
        }
        $this->refCounts[$connId]++;
        return $connId;
    }

    public function getResource(int $connId) {
        return $this->connections[$connId] ?? null;
    }

    public function release(int $connId): void {
        if (!isset($this->refCounts[$connId])) {
            return;
        }
        $this->refCounts[$connId]--;
        if ($this->refCounts[$connId] <= 0) {
            if (isset($this->connections[$connId])) {
                imagedestroy($this->connections[$connId]);
                unset($this->connections[$connId]);
                unset($this->refCounts[$connId]);
            }
        }
    }
}

class ImageBuffer {
    private $resource;
    private int $connId;
    private bool $ownsResource;
    private bool $released = false;

    public function __construct($resource, int $connId, bool $ownsResource = false) {
        $this->resource = $resource;
        $this->connId = $connId;
        $this->ownsResource = $ownsResource;
    }

    public function getResource() {
        return $this->resource;
    }

    public function getConnId(): int {
        return $this->connId;
    }

    public function detach(): self {
        $copy = imagecreatetruecolor(imagesx($this->resource), imagesy($this->resource));
        imagecopy($copy, $this->resource, 0, 0, 0, 0, imagesx($this->resource), imagesy($this->resource));
        return new self($copy, $this->connId, true);
    }

    public function transferOwnership(): void {
        $this->ownsResource = false;
        $this->released = true;
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        if ($this->ownsResource && is_resource($this->resource)) {
            imagedestroy($this->resource);
        }
        if (!$this->released) {
            ConnectionPool::getInstance()->release($this->connId);
            $this->released = true;
        }
    }
}

class ImagePipeline {
    private array $stages = [];
    private string $dsn;

    public function __construct(string $dsn) {
        $this->dsn = $dsn;
    }

    public function addStage(callable $stage): self {
        $this->stages[] = $stage;
        return $this;
    }

    public function process(string $inputPath): ImageBuffer {
        $pool = ConnectionPool::getInstance();
        $connId = $pool->acquire($this->dsn);

        if (!is_file($inputPath) || !is_readable($inputPath)) {
            $pool->release($connId);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Input path is not a readable file');
        }

        $data = file_get_contents($inputPath);
        if ($data === false || $data === '') {
            $pool->release($connId);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to read input file');
        }

        $image = imagecreatefromstring($data);
        if (!$image) {
            $pool->release($connId);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to load image');
        }

        $buffer = new ImageBuffer($image, $connId, true);

        foreach ($this->stages as $stage) {
            $oldBuffer = $buffer;
            $buffer = $stage($buffer);
            if ($buffer !== $oldBuffer) {
                $oldBuffer->transferOwnership();
            }
        }

        return $buffer;
    }
}

class ThumbnailGenerator {
    private ImagePipeline $pipeline;

    public function __construct(string $dsn) {
        $this->pipeline = new ImagePipeline($dsn);
        $this->pipeline
            ->addStage([$this, 'resize'])
            ->addStage([$this, 'sharpen']);
    }

    public function resize(ImageBuffer $buffer): ImageBuffer {
        $src = $buffer->getResource();
        $width = (int)(imagesx($src) * 0.5);
        $height = (int)(imagesy($src) * 0.5);
        $dst = imagecreatetruecolor($width, $height);
        imagecopyresampled($dst, $src, 0, 0, 0, 0, $width, $height, imagesx($src), imagesy($src));
        $connId = $buffer->getConnId();
        ConnectionPool::getInstance()->acquire('pool://image-cache-01');
        return new ImageBuffer($dst, $connId, true);
    }

    public function sharpen(ImageBuffer $buffer): ImageBuffer {
        $resource = $buffer->getResource();
        $matrix = [[0, -1, 0], [-1, 5, -1], [0, -1, 0]];
        imageconvolution($resource, $matrix, 1, 0);
        return $buffer;
    }

    public function generate(string $inputPath, string $outputPath): void {
        $result = $this->pipeline->process($inputPath);
        imagepng($result->getResource(), $outputPath);
        // $result goes out of scope here, triggering __destruct
    }
}

// Usage
$generator = new ThumbnailGenerator('pool://image-cache-01');
$generator->generate('/tmp/input.png', '/tmp/thumb.png');
